categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of organic silicon materials, including silicone monomers, intermediates, silicone rubber, silicone oil, silicone resin, and fumed silica. It operates an integrated production chain from silicon powder processing to downstream deep-processed products and by-product utilization. The main products serve diverse industries such as construction, electronics, automotive, medical, daily chemicals, and new energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis technologies including continuous hydrolysis of methylchlorosilanes, catalytic polymerization, and distillation for monomer separation. It has proprietary methods to reduce impurities and improve product purity and yield. The production involves complex fluidized bed catalytic reactions and downstream processing to produce various silicone-based products. The company holds numerous patents and has contributed to national and industry standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers span multiple sectors including construction, electronics, electrical power, automotive, medical, consumer goods, new energy, textiles, daily chemicals, machinery, composites, and chemicals. The company serves over 2,000 domestic and international customers, with exports to countries such as South Korea, Belgium, the USA, UAE, and India. Key end markets include electronics, power/new energy, and traditional sectors like construction and textiles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters and production facilities in Zibo City, Shandong Province. It has a broad domestic sales network covering major industrial clusters across provinces like Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Hebei, and Sichuan. Internationally, it exports to over 30 countries and regions including South Korea, Belgium, the United States, UAE, and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the organic silicon supply chain. It processes upstream raw materials such as silicon powder and chloromethane into silicone monomers and intermediates, and further manufactures downstream deep-processed products like silicone rubber, silicone oil, silicone resin, and fumed silica. It also manages by-product recycling and comprehensive utilization, forming a vertically integrated production system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on market-driven innovation, technological advancement, and product/application innovation to become a world-class silicone enterprise. R&D priorities include developing high-purity and specialty silicone materials, low-VOC electronic-grade silicones, special silicone sealants for new energy vehicles, and electronic-grade silicone gels and rubbers. The company emphasizes improving product quality, expanding downstream product lines, and enhancing by-product conversion efficiency while pursuing energy-saving and environmental protection technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of organic silicon chemical products including monomers, intermediates, and downstream silicone materials. The company operates a direct sales model with no reported subscription or licensing revenues. It also gains income from government subsidies and investment dividends. Export sales contribute a significant portion of revenue alongside domestic sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest producers in China's organic silicon industry with an annual capacity of 600,000 tons of silicone monomers, ranking among the top in scale and integration. It competes in a market characterized by increasing concentration among leading domestic players with strong technological and cost advantages. The industry is competitive with global players historically dominating but Chinese companies rapidly increasing market share. The company holds a leading position domestically with recognized industry awards and participation in national standards formulation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.15 billion, a 7.27% increase over 2023, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 56.76 million, reversing prior losses. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 6.37 billion with stable net assets around RMB 4.9 billion. It demonstrated improved cash flow from operations and maintained steady growth despite market price pressures. The company’s R&D investment was RMB 164 million, representing 3.19% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated production capacity, scale advantages, and comprehensive product portfolio covering upstream monomers to downstream specialty silicone products. It highlights strong R&D capabilities with numerous patents and participation in national standards, ensuring high product quality and innovation. Its value proposition includes stable supply, technical expertise, extensive customer service network, and environmental and safety management excellence, positioning it as a reliable supplier with differentiated high-performance silicone materials tailored for diverse industrial applications.
